entities.name: User Equipment

entities.name: PUCCH-CSI-Resources
entities.description: CSI resources configured in CSI-ReportConfig that are released upon PUCCH release request.

entities.name: SchedulingRequestResourceConfig instances
entities.description: Scheduling request resource configurations in PUCCH-Config that are released upon PUCCH release request.

entities.name: SRS-Resource instances
entities.description: SRS resource instances configured in SRS-Config that are released upon SRS release request.

entities.name: srs-PosRRC-InactiveConfig
entities.description: Positioning SRS configuration for RRC_INACTIVE state that is released upon positioning SRS release request.

relations.description: PUCCH release request triggers the release of PUCCH-CSI-Resources.
